reuse.why: expectedAmount is computed by the existing shared getScheduledAmount, the same function the rest of the app uses for a schedule's expected amount.

duplication.why: No rule logic is written; the API mapping only calls the shared helper.

placement.why: The field is added in scheduleModel.toExternal where API output is shaped, but the type is widened with an inline intersection on the method instead of a named output type, so api/schedules-get's handler type still omits it.

scope.why: One import, one field, a return-type tweak and a new focused test file.

maintainability.why: Any future change to the expected-amount rule flows to the API automatically; the ad hoc return type is a small wart for API consumers' typings.
